proposed.explanation: The investor asks for the percentage growth of Edita's net profit in 2025 versus 2024, with a plan to buy more if growth exceeds 50%. The only net‑profit figures in the evidence (EFID‑EFID_FY2025_EAS_consolidated_signed_en-p6-30 and p6‑31) are marked AMBIGUOUS because the 2025 value is covered by a stamp on the scanned page, rendering the figures unreliable for calculation. Consequently, we cannot determine the actual net‑profit growth, nor can we assess whether it exceeds the 50% threshold. Other figures (revenue, earnings per share) are not relevant to the net‑profit growth question. Because the necessary evidence is missing/ambiguous, a responsible decision cannot be made.
limitations: Net profit figures are ambiguous; 2025 value is obscured, so growth cannot be calculated.
No reliable net‑profit data available to evaluate the >50% growth condition.
